evals.prompt: Create a looping rainy street with roof collision, wet puddles and one timed lightning event.
evals.expected_output: An editable, scoped result with discipline-specific settings, actual evidence and stated unverified gates.
assertions: Uses consistent trajectory/raycast space and distinguishes analytic loops from cached simulation.
Preserves shared material/world animation and verifies baseline restoration.
Inspects final-resolution motion and exports engine masks rather than claiming runtime weather portability.

evals.prompt: Rain leaks under roofs, vertex masks differ from shader noise and lightning leaves a shared world permanently bright. Repair.
evals.expected_output: A diagnosis tied to the supplied failure, preserved sources, a concrete correction and repeated affected acceptance checks.
assertions: Uses consistent trajectory/raycast space and distinguishes analytic loops from cached simulation.
Preserves shared material/world animation and verifies baseline restoration.
Inspects final-resolution motion and exports engine masks rather than claiming runtime weather portability.
Does not label a hypothetical plan, a structural assertion or unrun workflow as successful execution.
